subject: general
question: The Karewa formations are found in the ____________
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kashmir Himalayas**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Karewa formations** indeed play a significant role in the geography and agriculture of the **Kashmir Himalayas**.
 
• These elevated plateaus provide fertile soil for various crops, contributing to the region's agricultural productivity.
 
• The** composition of Karewa deposits**, rich in various materials like sand, clay, silt, and gravel, supports the cultivation of a diverse range of crops, including saffron and various fruits like apples, peaches, almonds, walnuts, and apricots.
 
• The distinction between lower and upper stages of Karewa formations allows for a better understanding of the geological history and characteristics of these formations.
 
• The surrounding presence of the Greater and Lesser Himalayas further enhances the unique geographical setting of the Karewa formations, providing a picturesque landscape while also influencing the region's climate and ecology.
 
• Overall, Karewa formations stand as a testament to the dynamic geological processes that have shaped the Kashmir Himalayas, while also serving as the foundation for the agricultural prosperity of the region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The Purvanchal Hills** are a sub-mountain range of the Himalayas covering most of the northeastern states of India.
 
• **The Terai **is a lowland region in southern Nepal and parts of northern India.
 
• Uttarakhand, a **Himalayan state** in India, boasts several of the world's highest mountain peaks, with 15 peaks exceeding 7,000 meters in height.
